scope: Single queued/running foreground subagents only. No shell, parallel or chain handoff. No live model calls, end-to-end UI timings, or installed package performance claim.

audit.entry: AgentSession.prompt -> _tryExecuteExtensionCommand (while streaming) -> managed-tasks command/background -> subagent provider policy/state/schema checks -> ForegroundTask.detach
audit.execution: delegation -> subagent.execute -> existing scheduler reservation/run -> runSingleAgent -> SubagentProcessRun -> processLine -> bounded messages; same process, signal authority, timeout and task record
audit.publication: runSingleAgent startup/terminal only -> ForegroundTask.publish -> Agent snapshotObserverEvent clone/freeze -> AgentSession synchronous bridge -> InteractiveMode tool renderer -> unchanged frame queue
audit.release: detach removes parent listener, parent signal and original progress callback, resolves and clears foreground deferred callbacks. Operation remains in session pending set. runTasks finally clears execution metadata/map entry/reservation, terminal handler clears proxy controller/pending and chooses foreground result or one bounded background report.
audit.hotAllocations: Existing UTF-8 decode/string framing, JSON.parse and at most 3 bounded messages/child remain. No new per-chunk callbacks, Promise, AbortController, arrays, wrappers, full-message serialization or publication. Downstream snapshot/render allocations unchanged and audited; not asserted zero total.
audit.lifecycleAllocations: One ForegroundTask, controller, deferred and fixed callbacks per foreground single; one map entry within existing maxTasks (hard 256), one additional composite execution signal and completion observers. Command return/report wrappers only at handoff/completion. No timer, queue reservation or process creation on handoff. No object pool.
audit.capacity: Existing maxTasks bounds pending operations and foreground map; detach removes map entry, operation keeps reservation through final process/prompt cleanup; outputs <=3 messages/child and saved task <=12000 chars, completion report <=8192 UTF-16 chars.
audit.shellDecision: Foreground shell has no managed task record, cwd binding captures parent signal and Windows Job owner is chosen at spawn. Transfer unsupported; startup background remains available. No unsafe cancellation/restart to emulate transfer.

commands.integration: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern='real extension loading|unrelated tasks registration' tests/background-shell-tasks.test.ts
commands.benchmarkTypes: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --noEmit --target ES2023 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --allowImportingTsExtensions --skipLibCheck --strict scripts/bench/subagent-management.ts

validation.behavior: PID/task ID preserved; one running/outstanding/reserved slot before/after; late parent abort independent; exactly one completion; no late foreground publication; 8/8 full capacity queued handoff uses no new reservation; cancel/failure/permission/tree/shutdown retain existing ownership.
diagnosedIterations: Integration initially attempted a second Agent.dispatchHostTool while Agent was busy; corrected test to actual live /tasks command through ExtensionRunner, passed.

GC first showed 64 live parent signals only in aborted proxy owners. Clear proxy AbortController at terminal settlement rather than retaining its abort reason; all 768 parent/callback/wait references now collect while owners remain strongly held. No claim about untracked objects.

baseline.coverage: Production stdout/parse/retention methods; simulated baseline observer snapshot. Downstream TUI is covered separately by tui-tool-leaf-allocations.
